description: Confirm a suspected regression. Confirm a suspect: the item goes onto the trail with source `post_merge` and the suspect's evidence is kept. A person's call — the restricted ops key cannot confirm.

handle.description: The trail's handle (`T-12`) or its id.

suspectId.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

name: trails_confirm_suspect
